narration: Look at the middle, seven. Our target thirteen is bigger, so throw away the left half. New middle is eleven, still smaller. Next middle thirteen. Found in three steps.
description: Binary search for 13 in [1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15]. Show the array with lo, mid and hi pointers; each beat moves mid, marks the mid cell as compare, dims the discarded half; finish with 13 marked found and a note 'found in 3 steps'.
